items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Gates called 'Giant Steps.' And Bags had come up there with his vibes... Gates stepped in... Lionel Hampton really wanted blood... 15 guys on the bus

ctx.x: Yeah. Those guys, but boy I looked so forward. I would just wait for Gates. He’d say “bbbboys ‘Lady Be Good.’” Oh man, I would get so excited.
He’s still at it you know.
